records.Special Application/Referral Instruction:
Interested candidates should fill out the STEM Candidate Form to be connected with job opportunities by way of a recruiter: https://stemcandidateapply.apexsystems.com/.
After completing the form, send Rosalyn a note. This is NOT a referral process, however, this could potentially help to increase visibility of your application and candidacy.

Top recommendations when applying for jobs at Apex Systems:
Review and apply for Apex jobs at https://www.apexsystems.com/search-results-usa (we recommend applying when you have at least 80% of the requirements, and an interest in learning and doing the rest)
After you apply, Apex has an AI/Virtual Recruiter (Riley) who will reach out to you for a pre-screening. Get advice for engaging with AI recruitment technology in this article - https://www.apexsystems.com/insights/article/introducing-virtual-recruiter-riley (be sure to check out the FAQ guide at the bottom)
In addition to applying, take one additional outreach attempt. Get tips in this article! You can learn how via this ‘Finding a Recruiter’ demo video - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K4Qen-BqhxM
Once you have a Recruiting POC at Apex, for any Apex jobs you see posted via Indeed, LinkedIn, website, etc. that you’re 80%+ qualified for and interested in pursuing, first apply online (ideally customizing your resume) and then send the 1.) link and/or 2.) ID # to your Recruiting POC
Get more tips for an effective job search in this 1-hour on-demand training - 10 Key Job Seeker Activities - https://www.apexsystems.com/event/career-readiness/10-key-job-seeker-activities-gain-candidate-advantage

NO REFERRAL PROCESS
records.Additional Intel: Company information for roles are typically confidential until a certain point within the application/interview process. Opportunities could range from contracts, contract-to-hire, or direct hire.

If you have not already done so, BEFORE you apply for your next role of interest at IBM, you should...
Fill out this talent identification form to join IBM's talent network
Under the section, "School or University", be sure to list Code the Dream
After you complete the form, you will receive an IBM ID. Be sure to hold on to this for future use (don't lose it!)

AS you apply for jobs of interest at IBM...
There will be a portion in the job application that will ask you "Are you apart of the Talent Network?"
Select or type, "YES"
Provide your IBM ID

AFTER you apply, send Rosalyn a note via Slack with the following:
Email address
Resume

From there, she will reach out to the point-of-contact to let them know you've applied. They will then send your information to the role's designated recruiter.
records.Additional Intel: Interested applicants are encouraged to set up a saved job search/job alerts with IBM so you are able to get applications for jobs of interest in early. The hiring process for their jobs move rather quickly, so it is best to be an early applicant.
